about_the_game:
Unleash new possibilities for your dwarves with the Magic Mirror!

This DLC lets you change the appearance and outfits of your dwarves, giving each of them a unique style.

✨ What’s inside:

  • The Magic Mirror is available from the very beginning of a level and can also be crafted.

  • Two customization tabs:
    • Appearance – adjust face, hair, mustache, beard, and skin color.
    • Outfits – choose decorative items: hat, suit, and boots.

  • Option to display chosen clothing items instead of armor.

  • Collect new outfit sets and appearances as you progress through the levels — once discovered, they instantly become available in the mirror.

  • Dwarves will always look exactly as you set them up: in armor or in decorative outfits.

  • In multiplayer, each player unlocks appearances and outfits independently.

Create your dwarf’s own style and make your crew stand out!
